objective: Add seller-diverse, low-weight, train-only Chinese hard negatives so positive-pair mixup is a real minority-regularization experiment while keeping the component-safe validation/test benchmark unchanged.
hard_rules: Only existing zh_target_strict Step4 candidate pairs may be selected.
Every selected pair must already have a Step7 feature row.
Validation and test labels, rows, sellers, and components must remain unchanged.
Candidates sharing a seller with validation/test are forbidden.
Candidates inside any existing positive seller component are forbidden.
Shared contact or PGP candidates are forbidden from weak-negative expansion.
Existing positive and negative labels may not be converted.
Existing uncertain labels may not be converted; Step16G may only add previously unsupervised candidates.
At most two selected pairs may touch the same seller.
All additions are low-weight train-only weak supervision with benchmark_eligible=0.
The resulting imbalance is a training condition, not a change to the fixed evaluation prevalence.
